en.Отключает советы по Windows, «экран прив: Turns off Windows tips, the “welcome experience” after updates and the “finish setting up your device” reminders.
en.Это те же переключатели, что в Параметра: These are the same switches as in Settings → System → Notifications → Additional settings. It has no effect on performance — it removes annoying notifications and full-screen suggestions after updates. Undo it with UNDO in MONOLITH or in Settings.
en.Убирает рекламные блоки и «рекомендуемое: Removes ad blocks and “suggested content” from the Settings app.
en.Соответствует переключателю Параметры →: Matches the switch Settings → Privacy → General → “Show me suggested content in the Settings app”. Functionality does not change.
en.Убирает «забавные факты и советы» поверх: Removes “fun facts and tips” over the lock screen image.
en.Фоновое изображение «Windows: интересное: The “Windows Spotlight” background image stays — only the text ads on top of it are removed.
en.Убирает из меню «Пуск» рекомендации прил: Removes app and tip recommendations and Microsoft account reminders from the Start menu.
en.В Windows 11 — «Показывать рекомендации: In Windows 11: “Show recommendations for tips, shortcuts, new apps, and more” and account notifications; in Windows 10: “Occasionally show suggestions in Start”. Recent files and apps stay. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Отключает уведомления поставщиков синхро: Turns off sync provider notifications — OneDrive and Microsoft 365 ads in File Explorer windows.
en.Сам OneDrive продолжает работать как пре: OneDrive itself keeps working as before. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Политика полностью убирает раздел рекоме: The policy removes the recommendations section (recent files and apps) from the Start menu completely.
en.Официально политика поддерживается в Win: The policy is officially supported in Windows 11 SE and Education; Home and Pro may ignore it — then this item changes nothing, and it can be undone. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Убирает из раздела «Рекомендуем» меню «П: Removes websites that Windows picks from your browser history from the “Recommended” section of the Start menu.
en.Официальная политика Windows (HideRecomm: An official Windows policy (HideRecommendedPersonalizedSites) for the current user. Such recommendations appear only if the browser history is shared with Windows and contains enough sites — otherwise this item changes nothing noticeable. Recent files and apps in “Recommended” stay. The “Show websites from your browsing history” switch in Settings becomes unavailable, with a note that it is managed by your organization. Officially supported in Pro and higher editions. Undo removes the policy. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Нужна Windows 11 22H2 с обновлением KB50: Requires Windows 11 22H2 with update KB5027303 or newer.
en.Убирает из меню «Пуск» боковую панель «С: Removes the Phone Link side panel with your phone's messages, calls and photos from the Start menu.
en.Тот же переключатель, что Параметры → Пе: The same switch as Settings → Personalization → Start → “Show mobile device in Start”: it is not a policy, so you can bring the panel back there too. The Phone Link app itself keeps working as before. This item is shown only if the panel exists in your version of Windows and Phone Link. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Панели телефона в меню «Пуск» нет: нужна: There is no phone panel in Start: requires Windows 11 and a recent version of Phone Link.
en.Без рекламы сторонних приложений в «Инте: No third-party app ads in Spotlight
en.«Windows: интересное» и советы Windows п: Windows Spotlight and Windows tips stop promoting apps and content from third-party publishers.
en.Официальная политика Windows (DisableThi: An official Windows policy (DisableThirdPartySuggestions) for the current user; works in Pro and higher editions. The Windows Spotlight pictures on the lock screen and desktop stay. The effect is narrow: the main ads are already removed by “Windows tips and suggestions” and “Lock screen tips”; this one also covers third-party app promotion. The other Spotlight policies work only in Enterprise and Education, so MONOLITH does not offer them. Undo removes the policy. Takes effect after you sign out.
en.Windows Home не поддерживает эту политик: Windows Home does not support this policy.
en.Поиск в меню «Пуск» ищет только на компь: Start menu search looks only on your PC — no web results or Bing suggestions.
en.Поиск файлов, приложений и параметров ст: Searching for files, apps and settings gets faster and does not send what you type to the internet. Side effect: recent searches stop appearing in the File Explorer search box. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Убирает из поиска тематические картинки,: Removes themed pictures, “interesting today” and news from search.
en.Поле и окно поиска показывают только ваш: The search box and window show only your own results. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Убирает доску виджетов, её кнопку на пан: Removes the widgets board, its taskbar button and the WebView2 background processes that serve it.
en.Используется официальная политика Micros: Uses an official Microsoft policy (AllowNewsAndInterests). According to Microsoft, it also removes “weather and more” from the lock screen. The widgets package is not uninstalled, so everything comes back with Undo. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Windows 10: убирает с панели задач ленту: Windows 10: removes the news and weather feed from the taskbar along with its background processes.
en.Официальная политика Microsoft (EnableFe: An official Microsoft policy (EnableFeeds = 0) — the same as “Disable Widgets” for Windows 11. According to Microsoft, in Windows 10 it also removes “weather and more” from the lock screen, and “News and interests” disappears from the taskbar menu until you undo it. The policy is officially supported in Pro and higher editions; Home usually honors it too, but Microsoft does not guarantee this. Undo removes the policy, and your previous feed setting returns. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Только для Windows 10 — в Windows 11 исп: Windows 10 only — in Windows 11 use “Disable Widgets”.
en.Отключает встроенную боковую панель Copi: Turns off the built-in Copilot side panel and its taskbar button.
en.Действует только в Windows 11 22H2 и 23H: Works only in Windows 11 22H2 and 23H2 — in newer versions Copilot became a separate app from the Store, which this policy does not affect. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Только для Windows 11 22H2 и 23H2: в нов: Windows 11 22H2 and 23H2 only: in newer versions Copilot is a separate app.
en.Проводник показывает расширения всех фай: File Explorer shows the extensions of all files (.exe, .pdf, .zip).
en.Повышает безопасность: сразу видна подде: Improves security: a fake like “invoice.pdf.exe” is visible at once. Refresh the File Explorer window (F5) to see the change.
en.Проводник показывает скрытые файлы и пап: File Explorer shows hidden files and folders (for example, AppData).
en.Защищённые системные файлы по-прежнему с: Protected system files stay hidden. Handy when you need to find configs and game saves by hand.
en.Проводник открывается на «Этот компьютер: File Explorer opens to This PC
en.Новое окно Проводника открывается со спи: A new File Explorer window opens with the list of drives instead of Home.
A matter of convenience; it does not affect speed. Applies to new File Explorer windows.
en.«Главная» Проводника без недавних файлов: File Explorer Home without recent files
en.На «Главной» Проводника (в Windows 10 —: File Explorer Home (Quick access in Windows 10) does not show recently opened files or files from your Microsoft 365 / OneDrive account.
en.Те же флажки, что Параметры папок → Конф: The same checkboxes as Folder Options → Privacy: “Show recently used files”, “Show files from Office.com” and, in newer Windows 11 builds, “Show recommended section” (if your version has no such checkbox, the value has no effect). Useful when sharing your screen: recent documents are not visible to others, and File Explorer does not request cloud recommendations. Pinned and frequently used folders stay — MONOLITH does not turn off “frequent folders”, otherwise Home becomes empty. History and jump lists are not deleted. No policy is used, so you can restore the checkboxes by hand too. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Правый щелчок сразу открывает полное мен: Right-click opens the full menu at once, without the “Show more options” item.
en.Создаётся пустой COM-ключ, который отклю: Creates an empty COM key that turns off the new Windows 11 menu (the standard method, still working). Microsoft may change this in future updates — then the menu simply stays new. Undo removes the key. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Только для Windows 11 — в Windows 10 мен: Windows 11 only — in Windows 10 the menu is already classic.
en.Добавляет в меню правого клика по значку: Adds an “End task” item to the right-click menu of a taskbar icon — for frozen games and programs.
en.Работает как снятие задачи в Диспетчере: Works like ending a task in Task Manager: the process closes instantly and unsaved data is lost. The item itself closes nothing — it only appears in the menu. Takes effect after File Explorer restarts.
en.Нужна Windows 11 22H2 с обновлением KB50: Requires Windows 11 22H2 with update KB5030310 or newer.
en.Отключает анимации и тени интерфейса (ме: Turns off interface animations and shadows (menus, tooltips, windows, taskbar) but keeps font smoothing and thumbnails.
en.Интерфейс ощущается быстрее, особенно на: The interface feels faster, especially on weak integrated graphics. No effect in games: fullscreen output bypasses desktop composition. The previous value of each effect is saved and restored on undo. Animations turn off at once; File Explorer and taskbar effects — after File Explorer restarts.
en.не удалось прочитать текущие визуальные: could not read the current visual effects
en.Убирает эффекты прозрачности и размытия: Removes transparency and blur effects from the Start menu, taskbar and windows.
en.На дискретной видеокарте разница незамет: On a discrete graphics card the difference is not noticeable; on laptops with integrated graphics it takes a little load off the GPU. Fully takes effect after you sign out.
en.Задержка перед открытием вложенных меню: The delay before submenus open is reduced from 400 to 150 ms.
en.Влияет только на субъективную отзывчивос: Affects only how responsive the interface feels, not games. MONOLITH does not set the value to 0: menus start to flicker when you move the mouse. Takes effect after you sign out.
en.Снимает «Повышенную точность указателя»:: Turns off “Enhance pointer precision”: the cursor moves strictly in proportion to mouse movement.
en.Важно для шутеров и игр, которые использ: Important for shooters and games that use the system cursor: the same hand movement always gives the same cursor shift. Most modern games read the mouse directly (Raw Input) and do not depend on this setting. Pointer speed does not change. Takes effect after you sign out.
en.Без окна «Залипание клавиш» в играх: No Sticky Keys popup in games
en.Пятикратное нажатие Shift, долгое удержа: Pressing Shift five times, holding the right Shift key or Num Lock no longer opens the Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and Toggle Keys windows that minimize the game.
en.Выключаются только сочетания клавиш — ка: Only the keyboard shortcuts are turned off — like the “Keyboard shortcut for …” switches in Settings → Accessibility → Keyboard. The features themselves stay available there, and if one of them is already on, MONOLITH does not touch it. The other settings of these features are kept. FPS does not change — only the windows that steal focus from the game go away. Undo restores the previous values exactly; if you changed these features in Settings after applying, undo will restore their previous state too (Restore will show such changes). Takes effect after you sign out.
en.Залипание клавиш, фильтрация ввода и озв: Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and Toggle Keys are already on for you — MONOLITH does not touch them.
en.Windows перестаёт убавлять звук игры и м: Windows stops turning down game and music sound (by 80% by default) when a voice chat is open.
en.Это вариант «Ничего не делать» на вкладк: This is the “Do nothing” option on the Communications tab of the Sound panel. Ducking makes it hard to hear footsteps and shots while people talk in Discord or Teams; Discord has its own ducking, configured in Discord. The UserDuckingPreference = 3 value is stored in the user profile; Windows reads it after you sign out — to apply it right away, choose the same option on the Communications tab (mmsys.cpl). Undo restores the previous option; by default it is “Reduce the volume of other sounds by 80%”.
